# IContentContainer

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Structural contract for an element that wraps a single child.

Used by the layout engine to walk single-child wrappers generically (see `elementRequiresTwoPassLayout`) without needing to know every concrete type.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Properties

- [`child`](#child): The wrapped element, if any.
